I wanted to show my undergraduate thesis game that I presented at The 11th Workshop on Technology-Enhanced STEM (TeSTEM) Education at the 31st International Conference on Computers in Education (ICCE) in 2024\. 

| Game Name | Description | Links |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| AquaFarm Ace | A time-management game that showcases the aquaculture process of Oreochromis niloticus (nile tilapia). I was the developer and researcher in this. | [Archive Info](https://alls.ateneo.edu/archives/6751) [Playable Demo](https://angelancyap.itch.io/aquafarm-ace-v73) [Original Soundtrack](https://on.soundcloud.com/tYLqmviABwxJm64N6) |

After college, I joined the Ateneo Virtual Augmented and Mixed Reality Laboratory and worked on the Ateneo Virtual Reality Escape (AVRE) Framework and contributed in making Heritage Hero: The Villa Escudero VR Game. In which I only have an [old demo recorded](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P0k3pQ8xSvI). It is playable in Meta Quest 2/3. I had hands-on experience on game design and development from conceptualization to release, as well as usability testing and bug reporting. Part of my research allowed me to author and co-author research papers that were featured in the International Conference of Computers in Education, and Human-Computer Interaction International.  
These conference papers are titled:

* **Let Me Cook\! A Virtual Reality Game Exploring ADHD Symptomatology Through Routine Activities**   
* **RhythMotion: A Virtual Reality Rhythm Game for Neck and Arm Mobilization in Physical Therapy Patients**  
* **Improving Engagement in Museums through Virtual Reality Educational Escape Rooms (VREER): A Framework and Usability Study**  
* **Design and Implementation of an Educational Escape Rooms Class**  
* **A Streamlined Game Logic and Locomotion Authoring System for VR Escape Rooms**  
* **AquaFarm Ace: A Game on the Intensive Aquaculture Process of *Oreochromis niloticus***

This is a record of my involvement as a game thesis adviser in Ateneo de Manila University. I worked as a thesis adviser and panelist. These hopefully show how I helped game projects being published in fulfillment of their class. Hopefully it shows I am able to guide people in all stages of the game development process.

| Game Name | Description | Links |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |

Co-advised with Dr. Rodrigo. | [Playable Demo](https://mewwee.itch.io/saktolang) [Game Design Document](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ze-tfBtuoCY14vDyY7DeidMIXpr6K0_kmeuN3_te33M/edit?usp=sharing) |
| Aqualensia | A creature collection photo-snapping game about marine biodiversity. For this, I was a panelist only. | [Playable Demo](https://navicor.itch.io/aqualensia) [Game Design Document](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1FLjnjLjrQbYTbNLRQi-ls0gVGRKYL4LiYiVU9AT9YN8/edit?usp=sharing) |
| Solaristic | A tile-based puzzle game about solarpunk. Co-advised with Dr. Rodrigo. | [Playable Demo](https://tonic9087.itch.io/solaristic) Password: wildmill [Game Design Document](https://docs.google.com/document/d/17Z65nn9ghjohKslc6pEk8RfsugLHOSyh/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=102118093662129363725&rtpof=true&sd=true) |
| PasaHero | A 3D Platformer about super-commuting in the Philippines. Co-advised with Dr. Rodrigo. | [Playable Demo](https://realgabrieldelrosario.itch.io/pasahero) |
| FIRE\!: A Fire Simulation Game | A simulation game about fire prevention. Co-advised with Mr. Jesus Alvaro Pato. | No public links available as of the moment |
| Whispers of Himeji | A horror adventure game aimed for basic hiragana language learning. Co-advised with Mr. Dan Mark Restoles. | [Playable Demo](https://007heinekenlover.itch.io/whispers-of-himeji) |
| RhythMotion | A VR rhythm game about neck and arm mobility. Co-advised with Dr. Eric Vidal, Jr. | [HCII 2025 Paper](https://docs.google.com/document/d/13mSoXKEuwrTm4bU5VhHVvo_Zd3-slCt49wqsygtxQls/edit?tab=t.tgbexrypd3n6)  |

| Blue Eagle Beats | An experimental rhythm game to showcase Ateneo cheers. It includes gamified drum beat mechanics and minigames on tool maintenance. Co-advised with Mr. David Diy. | No public links available as of the moment |
| Deadline Duel | A top-down shooter and time management game about procrastination. | [Playable Demo](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1-MzO9BgGAPvsXk5YqdtOLU8_5A8ajKiA/view) |

I teach game design at Ateneo de Manila University. It covers topics on fun, and game balance. Applying frameworks such as the MDA, and Jesse Schell’s Elemental Tetrad. The requirements of this class involve teaching students on how to make a Game Design Document, a sell sheet (for Board Game and elevator pitches).

A record of my design work involves both my commissions and projects from my coursework in 3D Modelling Class. Here are screenshots of my Blender outputs. Over time, for 3D games that I worked on, especially on Heritage Hero: The Villa Escudero VR Game, I helped in specifying or fixing the models for the game.

# **Graphic Design Works**

Most of my graphic design work was made with the Adobe Creative Suite particularly Photoshop, Illustrator and Lightroom.

## **Hypothetical Concert**

In Graphic Design Practice, I was tasked to create a hypothetical concert. This was inspired from 1960’s **psychedelic design**, with Shawn Mendes as model.  
![][image3]![][image4]![][image5]![][image6]![][image7]

## **Blue Bird Improv**

I was an active member of Blue Bird Improv (BBI), a college improv organization that hosts shows. Most of my creative work was to create posters for the organization’s events. Often putting the mascot, Mercutio, in parodies.

## **Wedding Design** (Invitations)

I designed the wedding invitations for my uncle’s wedding. All were either for printing or for online viewing; including [the e-invite video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vAjl9RtULso). It was a rushed job but overall, it invokes the mood of and feel of the wedding. What I worked on as well is the poetry for the wedding; in which I have an [instagram account where I would share personal poetry](https://www.instagram.com/ggoems.repo?utm_source=ig_web_button_share_sheet&igsh=ZDNlZDc0MzIxNw==).

![][image23]![][image24]![][image25]![][image26]

## **60th Birthday** 

My aunt asked for me to design an invitation for her 60th birthday. This included the main invitations, the souvenirs and the central theme of her birthday which **was porcelain that outshines the diamonds.**
